title: GIS Developer & Analyst
teaser: Building WebGIS platforms and spatial data pipelines for municipal clients.
bullets: Architected a PostGIS + GeoServer stack serving live municipal asset data to a React/MapLibre front-end.
Built automated Python ETL pipelines converting shapefiles and satellite imagery into queryable spatial layers.
Reduced map-tile load times 60% by restructuring vector tile generation and caching.
Mentored two junior developers on spatial SQL and Leaflet integration.
